dedupe_keys.name: cross checked global monthly station precipitation 1901 2010

description: The University of Alberta compiled monthly precipitation records from more than 80,000 stations worldwide for 1901–2010. The Zenodo collection includes observed and estimated values, station-quality statistics and 1961–1990 climate normals with several spatial filters. Location and elevation checks used terrain models and neighbouring stations, while a linear model estimated missing observations from anomaly surfaces. Compressed CSV files are freely available under CC-BY-4.0. They can drive monthly water-balance, reservoir-supply and drought simulations, and complement gridded climate products with station-level provenance and quality ranks. Ten quality classes describe completeness and estimation reliability. Gap filling and spatial filtering are important limitations: different products contain different station subsets, and estimated precipitation should not be treated as measured. Monthly aggregation also prevents direct use for short-duration drainage design. The station-statistics file is necessary when selecting inputs and interpreting missing or reconstructed values.
